demos.name: Salesforce Privilege LAB
demos.description: A support engineer starts with no Salesforce Case access, asks Privilege for access to work a P1, and loses it again with a receipt. Also: connecting the org and linking people. Mock, or an owner-run read-only Real. Simulated from one real run.
demos.notes: Placeholder catalog id D000: the owner assigns the real one before the shelf registry PR. Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7835). Docker: docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only; Mock by default, Real only from this lab's own .env and secrets/). Mock makes zero outbound calls; Real is owner-run, read-only, one origin.
